validation.pixelReviewNotes: Pixel check: each side has one input splitting into exactly two abstract outputs. Greater obstruction nearly closes only the toward-lungs gate, narrows that arrow and enlarges bypass-to-body flow. Both directions are downstream and labels remain matched; explicit flow-analogy caption avoids a cardiac anatomy claim.
